observations: Photo shows a bicycle leaning indoors against a wall.
Front wheel and handlebar are visible; frame appears metal with a green/black color scheme.
No clear brand name, model number, or label is readable.
No close-up of drivetrain, brakes, tires condition, or any serial/ID plate.

claims.evidence: No readable brand/model or brake/gear specification in the photo.
Photo only shows the bicycle; no proof of test ride, brake function, or gear shifting.
Negotiation is not verifiable from the photo.

risks.risk: Brakes may not work properly (worn pads/rotors, misalignment, cable issues).
risks.proof: Short video of braking from a slow roll (front and rear) showing it stops smoothly without grinding/squeal.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used bicycle with unknown brake condition (worst case: brakes need service).

risks.risk: Gears may not shift correctly (derailleur misadjusted, bent derailleur, worn cassette/chain).
risks.proof: Video showing shifting through all gears while pedaling, with clear gear engagement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not reliably shifting (worst case: gear service needed).

risks.risk: Tires may be worn or punctured (dry rot, low tread, sidewall cracks).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tire tread + sidewalls, and a quick pump/pressure check screenshot or video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tires may need replacement.

risks.risk: Wheel alignment/rims may be bent or bearings worn (wobble, grinding).
risks.proof: Spin each wheel and show wobble; listen for grinding; close-up of rim edges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as wheels/bearings may need attention.

risks.risk: Missing parts or poor condition not visible from this angle (chain, pedals, seat, lights, reflectors).
risks.proof: Full set of photos: drivetrain close-up (chain/cassette), both brake levers, pedals, seat post, and rear derailleur.

proof_requests: Video test: brakes (front + rear) from a slow roll.
Video test: shift through all gears while pedaling.
Close-up photos of drivetrain (chain + cassette/freewheel + rear derailleur).
Close-up photos of tires tread and sidewalls (and any puncture repairs).
Photos of wheel rims and a wheel-spin video to check wobble/bearings.
response.reason: The photo confirms it’s a bicycle, but key value drivers (brakes, gear shifting, tire/wheel condition) are not provable from a single distant shot. To price safely, request quick functional videos and close-ups of the drivetrain and tires.
